actions.description: Test recovery of stranded processing job
actions.command:
set -e
DB=/var/lib/job-queue/jobs.sqlite3
# Simulate a crashed worker: leave a job stranded in 'processing' with no result.
sqlite3 $DB "INSERT INTO jobs(id,payload,status,result,attempts) VALUES('crash-recover-001','stranded','processing',NULL,0);"
echo "Stranded row before worker restart:"; sqlite3 $DB "SELECT id,status,result,attempts FROM jobs WHERE id='crash-recover-001';"
# Restart worker to trigger recovery path.
systemctl restart queue-worker
sleep 1
echo "After worker restart:"; sqlite3 $DB "SELECT id,status,result,attempts FROM jobs WHERE id='crash-recover-001';"
curl -s http://localhost:8080/jobs/crash-recover-001; echo
